verdict.rationale: Clara documents labels that attach GL codes, cost centers, or project IDs to transactions, and a reconciliation workflow that categorizes transactions and exports them to accounting. Signed transaction webhooks and category-level spend analysis support near-real-time handling, and marketing copy claims automated expense reporting. However, the reconciliation guide frames coding as a billing-period step rather than coding at the point of spend. Missing for 10: receipt capture or matching, memo fields, evidence that coding happens automatically or at the moment of the transaction, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
